headline: Houston Students Launch Affordable Auto Shop for Local Drivers
meta_description: High school students in Houston opened a public auto shop offering oil changes, tire rotations, and inspections for just $20–$35 under instructor supervision.
summary_short: Houston high school students have opened a public auto shop where they service local residents' cars under instructor supervision at remarkably low prices.
body:
Houston high school students have opened a public auto shop where they service local residents' cars under instructor supervision. The enterprise offers oil changes, tire rotations, and inspections for just $20 to $35—a fraction of typical commercial rates.

The initiative combines practical vocational learning with genuine community benefit. Students gain hands-on experience in automotive maintenance while residents gain access to reliable, affordable car care. By working under trained instructors, the young technicians develop real-world skills in a controlled, educational environment.

This model turns a school facility into a genuine neighborhood resource, proving that education and service can advance together. Residents get their vehicles properly maintained at accessible prices, while students build competence and confidence in a trade that remains in high demand.
quick_facts: Houston high school students opened a public auto shop
Services include oil changes, tire rotations, and inspections
Prices range from $20 to $35 per service
